patch_description:
Revert to the high-scoring RY-RZ-CZ architecture (0.72 score, 14 params) which outperforms the current XX variant (0.68 score, 20 params). The current design adds Ising gates that increase parameter count without improving accuracy or efficiency.

Then add a shared RX initialization layer before the main ansatz, following the expert recommendation. This provides a single-axis RX kickstart (1 shared parameter) to diversify initial state sampling and potentially improve convergence speed, while maintaining minimal parameter overhead.

The final gate sequence will be:
1. RX initialization (shared across all 8 qubits) - 1 new parameter
2. RY layer (shared) - 1 parameter (reused)
3. RZ layer (shared) - 1 parameter (reused)
4. CZ chain (fixed, no params)
5. RZ layer (shared) - reuses same parameter

Total: ~3 parameters, proven architecture, improved initialization.
